description: One-time discovery that teaches the spec-driven-dev pipeline how THIS project works, and saves the answers to .spec-driven.yml — project layout (single repo, monorepo, or multiple repos), issue tracker, base branch, PR target, branch naming, commit style, and the lint/typecheck/test/ build/dev commands. Use when the user says "set up spec-driven", "configure the pipeline", "spec-setup", "change our branch rules", or when any other spec-* skill finds no .spec-driven.yml. Detects everything it can from the repos first and only asks about what is ambiguous. Writes config only — never changes code, branches, or commits.
